referenceTape: Ampex 456, later Quantegy 456. Its manufacturer data sheet is used as a benchmark only; this is not a claim of equivalence to that product.
status: documentation-derived; not validated against tape; not listened to

evidence.coatingThicknessMicrons: published: manufacturer data sheet (2003), oxide coating 500 microinches, 12.7 micrometres. Earlier sheets give 0.55 mil
evidence.molDb: published: manufacturer data sheet, output level at 3 percent third harmonic distortion at 1 kHz, +12.3 dB. The sheet's reference level is taken to be 185 nWb/m, which is an assumption
evidence.overbias: published: manufacturer data sheet, recommended bias setting 3.0 dB, found by raising bias past the 10 kHz peak. The test speed is assumed to be 15 in/s
